args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18 in status check). v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback status: rolled_out, verified. Next steps: confirm error rate recovery, investigate v2.3.1 regression before re-release.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and it is reporting healthy with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18 on v2.3.1.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the v2.3.1 health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0, and it paged the on-call engineer.
- **Follow-up:** The incident lists two next steps: confirm the error rate stays down, and investigate the v2.3.1 regression before it is released again.

content.text: I'll start by checking the release history and current status for checkout-api so I can identify the most recent healthy release.
The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in all three regions, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback is verified in all three regions. Next I'll confirm health and open the SEV2 incident.
